verdict.rationale: Make hosts a live llms.txt at developers.make.com/llms.txt (verified 200 with actual content listing doc pages), and it also publishes agent-oriented 'Make Skills' markdown files specifically designed to help AI assistants perform Make tasks and connect to its MCP server. This directly satisfies the story of pointing an agent at llms.txt or agent-native docs. Missing for 10: consistent .md mirrors for all doc pages (one page probed 404'd) and independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent successfully consumes these files end-to-end.
